description: Trowel Continued is an unofficial, maintained fork of the original Trowel mod by TheEnderCore.  This fork updates the mod for modern Minecraft and Fabric versions while preserving its original random-block placement behavior.

mods.name: Trowel Continued
mods.description: An unofficial maintained fork of Trowel (by TheEnderCore) updated for modern Fabric Minecraft versions.

releases.notes:
## Crafting Recipe Fix

This update fixes the Trowel crafting recipe and recipe-book unlock on **Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric)**.

### Fixed
- Fixed outdated resource folders that prevented Minecraft from loading the recipe and advancements.
- Updated the recipe format and corrected references to the original mod’s item.
- Restored the recipe-book unlock when obtaining an iron ingot.
- Fixed the Trowel story advancement’s item reference and icon format.
- Corrected the Ukrainian item translation key.

The crafting recipe remains unchanged: **two iron ingots and one stick**.

### Verification
- Gradle build completed successfully.
- Confirmed the built JAR contains the corrected resource paths.
- Confirmed a dedicated Fabric server loads the recipe and advancements without parsing errors.

### Installation
Replace the previous Trowel Continued JAR on **both your client and server**, then restart them.

Thanks to the player who reported this in #1!
